passport.content.h1: How to Create Official Passport Photos Online & Print at Home
passport.content.p1a: Getting passport, visa, or ID photos taken at a pharmacy or studio often costs $15–$25 per set. With modern smartphone cameras and ImgFeel's free online Passport Photo Maker, you can create compliant, professional passport photos at home in minutes for pennies.
passport.content.p1b: Our client-side tool allows you to crop photos to exact country specifications, align your face with biometric safe zone overlays, enhance lighting and background color, and arrange multiple copies on a standard 4×6-inch photo paper sheet ready for instant printing at 300 DPI.
passport.content.feat1Desc: Your personal identity photos are never uploaded or stored on any remote server. Everything processes locally inside your browser.
passport.content.feat2Desc: Pre-configured dimensions for US (2×2"), UK/EU/Schengen (35×45 mm), India, Canada (50×70 mm), China (33×48 mm), and custom sizes.
passport.content.feat3Desc: Interactive head oval, eye line, crown, and chin guides ensure your face occupies the required 70%–80% area to prevent application rejection.
passport.content.feat4Desc: Tile 2, 4, 6, or 8 photos with cutting guides onto standard 4×6", 5×7", or A4 sheets for high-definition 300 DPI printing.
passport.content.h2: Step-by-Step Guide: Making a Passport Photo at Home
passport.content.p2a: Follow these four easy steps to prepare your passport photo from start to finish:
passport.content.step1Desc: Stand 4–6 feet from the camera against a plain background in good natural lighting. Keep a neutral facial expression with both eyes open.
passport.content.step2Desc: Upload your photo and select your target country. Use the zoom and pan controls to align your head inside the biometric oval.
passport.content.step3Desc: Fine-tune brightness and contrast, or select pure white or light off-white background tinting to meet official guidelines.
passport.content.step4Desc: Switch to the Printable Sheet tab, choose 4×6" photo paper, download the 300 DPI sheet, and print at any photo lab for under 50 cents.
passport.content.h3: Standard Passport & Visa Photo Dimensions Across Major Countries
passport.content.p3a: Passport photo specifications vary by country and document type. Here is a quick reference guide:
passport.content.dim1Desc: Requires 600×600 px at 300 DPI. Head must be between 1 inch and 1 3/8 inches (25–35 mm) from bottom of chin to top of head. Plain white or off-white background.
passport.content.dim2Title: UK, European Union & Schengen Visa — 35×45 mm
passport.content.dim2Desc: Requires 413×531 px at 300 DPI. Head height from chin to crown must be 32–36 mm (approx. 70–80% of photo height). Light gray or cream background.
passport.content.dim3Desc: Requires 591×827 px at 300 DPI. Face length from chin to crown must measure between 31 mm and 36 mm. Plain white or light-colored background.
passport.content.dim4Desc: Requires 390×567 px at 300 DPI. Head width must be 15–22 mm, head height 28–33 mm. Pure white background required.
passport.content.h4: Essential Photo Guidelines to Avoid Passport Application Rejections
passport.content.p4a: Government passport offices reject thousands of photos each year due to avoidable mistakes. Follow these strict rules:
passport.content.tip1Desc: Remove all eyeglasses, sunglasses, and colored contact lenses unless accompanied by a signed medical statement.
passport.content.tip2Desc: Keep both eyes wide open and mouth closed. Avoid smiling, frowning, or raising your eyebrows.
passport.content.tip3Desc: Ensure light is balanced across your face. Avoid harsh directional shadows on your face or on the background wall.
passport.content.tip4Desc: Wear everyday clothing with good contrast against the white wall. No uniforms or head coverings (except for recognized religious/medical reasons).
passport.content.h5: How to Print Multiple Passport Photos on a 4×6 Sheet for Under $0.50
passport.content.p5a: Save up to 95% on passport photos using our printable sheet layout feature:
passport.content.print1Desc: A standard 4×6-inch photo print costs less than $0.50 at pharmacies (Walgreens, CVS), supermarkets, or local photo kiosks.
passport.content.print2Desc: Our tool automatically tiles up to 6 US (2×2") or 8 EU (35×45 mm) photos with cutting guides at true 300 DPI resolution.
passport.content.print3Title: Order as a Standard 4×6 Photo Print
passport.content.print3Desc: Upload the downloaded sheet to any photo lab website as a standard 4×6 print (do not order under their specialized 'passport photo' category).
passport.content.print4Desc: Use scissors or a paper trimmer along the dotted cutting lines for razor-sharp, official-sized passport photo prints.
passport.content.p6a: Passport, visa, and citizenship photo regulations are subject to strict legal requirements set by respective government authorities (e.g., US Department of State, UK HM Passport Office, European Commission). While ImgFeel adheres to standard published biometric guidelines, always verify the latest official photo rules for your specific issuing authority before submitting your application.
passport.content.faq1Q: Is this Passport Photo Maker completely free to use?
passport.content.faq1A: Yes! ImgFeel's Passport Photo Maker is 100% free with unlimited single and sheet photo downloads and zero watermarks.
passport.content.faq2Q: Are my uploaded personal portrait photos secure and private?
passport.content.faq2A: Yes, absolutely. All photo cropping, biometric framing, and sheet generation occur locally in your browser. Your images are never sent to external servers.
passport.content.faq3Q: How many passport photos fit on a single 4×6 inch sheet?
passport.content.faq3A: A standard 4×6-inch sheet fits up to six 2×2-inch (US/India) photos or up to eight 35×45 mm (UK/EU/Schengen) photos with margins and cutting guides.
passport.content.faq4Q: What resolution and DPI does the tool export?
passport.content.faq4A: All single photos and printable sheets are generated at high-definition 300 DPI resolution, meeting official government printing standards.
passport.content.faq5Q: Can I take a passport photo with my phone?
passport.content.faq5A: Yes! Use the rear camera in good natural daylight, stand 4–6 feet away with a straight head posture, and upload the photo to our tool for automatic cropping.
passport.content.faq6Q: What background color is required for passport photos?
passport.content.faq6A: Most countries (including the US, India, and Canada) require a plain white or off-white background. The UK and Schengen countries accept plain light gray or cream.
passport.content.faq7Q: How do I print the sheet without accidental scaling?
passport.content.faq7A: When printing at home or at a kiosk, ensure the printer settings are set to '100% Scale' or 'Actual Size' with 'Fit to Page' unchecked.
